subject: Control colors in a stacked error bar plot

messages.subject: Control colors in a stacked error bar plot
parts:
Hi All,

 I am trying to draw a stacked error bar plot but can't figure out how to control the colors of the primary bars and corresponding error bars. I would like different colors for the two error bars and also would like to choose the colors for the primary bars too.

My data set has 4 columns:

Chromosome   Mean   SE   group
1   0.139000   0.089   1
1   0.014769   0.01137   2
2   0.118000   0.086   1
2   0.004157   0.010866   2
......
....
..

and here's my code at this moment:

x11(width=10, height=5)
gg<-qplot(factor(Chromosome), Mean, fill=group, data=d, geom="bar", position="dodge",stat="identity",ylab="Phenotypic variability explained\n",xlab="Chromosome")
dodge <- position_dodge(width=0.9)
gg+geom_linerange(aes(ymax=Mean+SE, ymin=Mean), size=1.2)+
theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size=20, face="bold"), axis.title.y = element_text(size=20, face="bold"), axis.text.x=element_text(face="bold", colour="black", size=20), axis.text.y=element_text(face="bold",colour="black", size=20),legend.position = "none")

Thanks,

-Joey
